title: Reading Drill — Moving Music Lessons Online
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Moving Music Lessons Online
passages.body:
**A** A music school offered some one-to-one lessons by video. At first the teachers tried to play along with their pupils, but a slight delay meant that even accurate playing sounded out of time.

**B** The teachers adapted by taking turns. They shared backing tracks in advance so pupils could practise to a steady accompaniment without needing the teacher to play during the call.

**C** The school kept group rehearsals in person. It used online lessons mainly for technique and left ensemble skills to rehearsals where pupils could respond to each other immediately.
